Merge two simulated detectors into a capture history table

Source: R/callDensitySim.R
simsTocaptureHistoryTable.Rd

Merge two simulated detectors into a capture history table

Usage

simsTocaptureHistoryTable(
  subsampleDet1,
  subsampleDet2,
  observerSuffix = c("observer1", "observer2")
)

Arguments

subsampleDet1, subsampleDet2

Output of simulateDetector for each of the two simulated detectors.

observerSuffix

Character vector of length 2 giving the suffix used for the two detection-flag columns in the output. Default c('observer1', 'observer2') – matchbox-native, matching chtToSNRinfo's own default observers naming, so a simulated capture history table needs no renaming before use. Pass c('table1', 'table2') for the older detect_table1/detect_table2 shape.

Only the two detection-flag columns are affected. The per-observer groundTruth/snr/signalRMSdB/noiseRMSdB columns keep their existing 1/2 numbering regardless – they're simulation-only ground-truth/diagnostic columns with no equivalent in real matchbox output (which carries one shared signalRMSdB/noiseRMSdB per matched event, already consolidated below, and no ground truth at all), so there's no matchbox convention for observerSuffix to align them to.
